verdict.rationale: Factory integrates with Slack, Jira, Linear, PagerDuty and other team tools, and its tiered-autonomy/approval model implies a point where the agent pauses for developer input, but there is no explicit documentation of a notification mechanism (e.g., push alert, Slack message) firing when a droid finishes a task or needs approval. Missions and sessions can be monitored live, which is adjacent but not the same as proactive notification. Missing for 10: explicit notification/alerting feature description, evidence of Slack/PagerDuty being used to alert on task completion or approval requests, and any hands-on confirmation this works.
